input.contract_yaml:
# Provider roster from a vendor: one row per provider, one file per day.
feed: healthcare.provider_roster
version: 1
owner: vendor-ops@example.com
description: >
  Daily provider roster: every provider with taxonomy, practice state and
  whether they accept new patients. All data is synthetic.
classification: restricted
source:
  channels: [minio, sftp, api]
  filename_pattern: "provider_roster_*.csv"
  # The business date in the name (provider_roster_YYYYMMDD.csv). It must be a real date, not after
  # the day the file was received, and at most 7 days before it; otherwise the file is
  # quarantined (FILE.NAME_DATE). A name with no digits takes the date it was received.
  filename_date:
    regex: "^provider_roster_([0-9]+)"
    format: "%Y%m%d"
    max_days_before_received: 7
    max_days_after_received: 0
format: { type: csv, delimiter: ",", encoding: utf-8, header: true }
expected_arrival: { cron: "0 6 * * *", grace: 2h }
on_row_violation: quarantine_row
max_bad_row_ratio: 0.05          # above this, the whole file is rejected
min_rows: 1
columns:
  - { name: npi, type: integer, required: true, unique: true, pattern: "^[0-9]{10}$", phi: true }
  - { name: provider_first_name, type: string, required: true, phi: true }
  - { name: provider_last_name, type: string, required: true, phi: true }
  - { name: taxonomy_code, type: string, required: true, pattern: "^[0-9]{3}[A-Z][0-9]{5}[A-Z]$" }
  - { name: practice_state, type: string, required: true, allowed: [CT, NJ, NY] }
  - { name: accepting_new_patients, type: string, required: true, allowed: [N, Y] }
  - { name: effective_date, type: date, required: true }

content.text:
I submitted the version 1 contract for `healthcare.provider_roster` (candidate a6e71ebe51b70186), and a person will review it before it is published.
- **File:** `provider_roster_20261019.csv`, UTF-8, comma-delimited, 24 rows, 7 columns, all named and in the expected order, with no empty values.
- **Contract:** npi is an integer, required, unique, with a 10-digit pattern. The two name columns are required and PHI. taxonomy_code has a pattern. practice_state and accepting_new_patients are restricted to the observed codes. effective_date is a required date. The source, filename-date, format and threshold settings are copied from the eligibility contract, with the filename pattern changed to `provider_roster_YYYYMMDD`.
- **Loosening:** the validator reported none.
- **Dry run:** 24 accepted, 0 rejected, and the file was not rejected.

The filename pattern, channels, and arrival schedule are my assumptions from the eligibility contract, not from anything the vendor specified, so the reviewer should confirm them.
